We've finally found the best Reflective Pink PLA filament in Australia! This is a 1Kg reel of 1.75mm Reflective Pink PLA (polylactic acid) plastic filament for 3D printing. PLA is a bioplastic and makes for a great general-purpose filament with smooth surface finish. This filament is very easy to print and is even biodegradable! PLA has minimal warping and shrinking compared with other materials, which makes it ideal for printing objects featuring flat surfaces and hard angles, or requiring tight tolerances for fit.

PLA filament has been commonly used in situations that require prototypes, educational and architectural models, and artefact replicas built with ease and alacrity. This filament is also capable of being treated with a variety of post-processing techniques, making it a popular choice for users looking to paint objects after they have been printed, such as costume props and figurines. The material comes on a heavy-duty plastic reel and vacuum sealed to keep out any moisture.

Note: PLA is relatively brittle, so it is not recommended for thin, high-strength applications.

Jargon buster

Plain-language definitions for the technical terms used above.

PLA
PLA, or polylactic acid, is a common 3D-printer plastic made from plant-derived materials. It matters because PLA is easy to print with low warping, but it is more brittle and less heat-resistant than some other filament types.
